content_patterns: Uppercase, letter-spaced field labels matching Register screen. Placeholder uses concrete local example ('e.g. +62 812 3456 7890'). Explicit '(Optional)' annotation for non-required fields. Helper text explains consequences ('This currency will be used for all reports and summaries.'). Verb-first button copy: 'Save Changes', 'Sign Out'. Instructional hint under avatar: 'Tap to change avatar'.
notable_interactions: Avatar edit badge implies tap-to-upload/change photo. Currency dropdown shows selected state with checkmark implying selectable list. Save button separated by a full-width divider implies form submission; Sign Out is styled as destructive but outlined rather than solid red. Back arrow implies return to Settings root.
